race.comment: REGAL PROBLEM (12) comes here in peak condition and looks up to this level with the 2.5kg weight drop. Worth noting Rawiller sticks after warming up late when fifth over 1300m at Warwick Farm in BM72 class. Leading player expected to go close. BESIDE THE OCEAN (4) tongue-tie goes on and strips fitter after her below-par sixth over 1400m at Randwick Kensington. Just under a month between runs on that occasion and the claim helps. CHIX (7) sprinted well first up for a comfortable on-pace victory over 1250m at Randwick Kensington. Will put herself on the speed again and looks set for a big campaign. METALLIC CAT (5) is undefeated at this trip and a win looks imminent with her solid SP profile. Winning rider hops aboard and will prove hard to get past in this tougher contest. ERTIJAAJ (3) raced a bit flat second up in a much stronger contest. Assess on her sharp first-up victory. Expected to take a hand in the finish.
